item.title: Composition Analysis and Identification of Ancient Glass Artifacts
item.description: Analyzed weathering patterns, composition changes, and type identification for ancient glass artifacts through data cleaning, statistical testing, clustering, classification, sensitivity analysis, and relational interpretation.

item.title: MCM Forest Management | Multi-Objective Modeling of Carbon, Economy, and Water Conservation
item.description: Built layered models for forest carbon sequestration, harvesting economics, and water conservation, then applied a multi-objective management plan to larch and Mongolian oak forests in eastern Liaoning.
